items.event_time_ist: ~9:30 AM IST, Oct 17 (reel of overnight press scrum)
items.title: Ajinkya Shinde's overnight press scrum: police still haven't confirmed Dipke's location after 8+ hours
items.summary: Verified Saam TV (3.1M followers) Marathi reel posted ~9:30 AM IST Oct 17 shows CJP's interim national organisation head Ajinkya Shinde addressing the media overnight outside Parliament Street police station: he says he personally went to the station yet Delhi Police have still not confirmed founder Abhijeet Dipke's location, held for over eight hours since Friday-evening's detention; on-screen graphics read 'Abhijeet Dipke still not released' and 'Police not giving official information.' Dipke's production before the Special Executive Magistrate court (expected today, Oct 17) remains pending. The underlying whereabouts dispute was reported earlier; Shinde's in-person visit and public statement are new.

items.event_time_ist: announced ~8:41 AM IST, Oct 17; march scheduled 2:00 PM IST, Oct 17
items.title: News Nation: CJP + student orgs (AISA, AISF, SFI) announced a 2 PM march today from Press Club to Jantar Mantar
items.summary: News Nation TV's verified IG (1.1M followers) breaking-news bulletin posted ~8:41 AM IST Oct 17 reports an announcement of a fresh protest today: CJP workers plus student organisations AISA, AISF and SFI are preparing to march from the Press Club to Jantar Mantar at 2:00 PM IST today (Oct 17). No second outlet has carried the plan yet, and no police response or permission status has been reported. Jantar Mantar remains de-notified as a protest venue since Oct 12 and BNSS 163 curbs apply in central Delhi.
